text:
Notice to all shipowners, ship operators and ship managers; fishing vessel owners and managers; employers of seafarers and fishermen; masters, skippers, officers and seafarers and fishermen.

This notice should be read with the Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Medical Certification) Regulations 2010 and the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) (Medical Certification) Regulations 2018.

This MIN expires 31 December 2028.
